steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Back to the main issue...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh right, the main issue!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: So little boss, what exactly is this movie that we're making?
OwO shifts her eyes around.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The coolest, hottest, and most fun movie that'll ever get made, of course!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh wow wow! That's great. What are we waiting for? Let's start shooting!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: ...What I meant by "main issue" is how are we going to lose those guys who are chasing us...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ugh, what are you panicking for, Daisy? They won't find us here anytime soon.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Don't worry. I've already figured out how to deal with them.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: How?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, I've got a plan that'll both help us make our movie and solve the problem of getting hunted down.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Really? We can get rid of them while making a movie? Can I be the lead actress?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No problem! You're Love the superstar. The lead role is naturally yours.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Come, come. I have the script already. This is the plan...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: In chaotic, violent Syndicate, there are two ancient clans. They have feuded for generations, each harboring intense hatred for the other...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: However, the Rumeo clan's youngest son fell in love with the Chocoliet clan's daughter. The two eloped and ran away.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The wicked patriarch of the Rumeo clan would never allow something that brings dishonor to the clan like this to happen.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: He led his clan members to the manor where the couple meets, intending to tear the poor girl to shreds...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: But when they rushed into the manor, they realized they had made a huge mistake!

steps.speaker: Gang Member A
steps.content: "Boss, it's a trap!"

steps.speaker: Gang Member B
steps.content: "Her firepower is too much! We can't hold out against her!"

steps.speaker: Scarface Love
steps.content: "Hmph, didn't expect that, did you? I'm not some damsel in distress who eloped for love. I'm a femme fatale who kidnapped the Rumeo boy to lure you here and catch you all!"

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The Rumeo thugs got pummeled. Only when the smoke cleared from her muzzle did they see her face.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: She is... "Scarface," Love!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Haha, didn't expect that, did you? I'm not some damsel in distress who eloped... hey hey hey! Dude!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Th-they're not supposed to be doing that! I haven't finished my lines yet!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ugh... The extras are really bad quality. I guess it can't be helped.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: What do we do now?

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: My suggestion is...

steps.speaker: OwO & Lil Daisy
steps.content: Run!
